prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: The most practical prompts — copy and paste them into Cluega, then replace everything inside the square brackets [ ] with your own information.

accountHealth.title: Account health audit
accountHealth.body: Scan every ad account and surface the top 5 issues ranked by estimated dollar impact — including budget waste, quality score, and creative match — with the expected gain from fixing each one.

weeklyDiagnosis.title: Weekly diagnosis
weeklyDiagnosis.body: Compare the last 7 days against the previous 7 across every platform, find the biggest swings in ROAS, CPA, and CPC, analyze the root causes, and separate branded from non-branded traffic.

threeOpportunities.title: Ten big opportunities
threeOpportunities.body: Look across Google + Meta to find the top 10 optimization opportunities, ranked by estimated dollar impact, each with concrete next steps and an expected improvement range.

negativeKeywords.title: Negative keyword scan
negativeKeywords.body: Pull the last 30 days of search-term reports, find the 20 keywords wasting the most budget, analyze why conversions are low, and return a recommended negative-keyword list.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Turn on built-in skills so Cluega automatically applies the right capability to each task.
skills.bannerDescription: Add a skill to unlock new capabilities for you or your team.

tiktok.name: tiktok-ads-generator
tiktok.body: A high-conversion short-video ad script and storyboard generator built for TikTok. It automatically produces scroll-stopping hooks, layered pain points, and strong CTAs to lift creative quality across the board.

meta.name: meta-creative-matrix
meta.body: A multi-variant ad copy and visual matrix planner for Meta (Facebook / Instagram). It automatically derives the best copy combinations based on audience warmth.

google.name: google-search-optimizer
google.body: A Google search ad optimization expert. It automatically gauges industry competitiveness, batch-generates highly relevant headlines and descriptions, and intelligently filters out low-performing traffic terms.

omni.name: omni-ad-brief-compiler
omni.body: A cross-platform creative brief automation tool. With one click it turns product selling points into shooting directions and design notes that match each platform's specs.

managed.title: About managed tasks
managed.description: For ad delivery, analysis, and reporting scenarios, pick the matching fully-managed skill module — once configured, the AI runs it automatically 7×24.

highRoas.title: High-ROAS auto bid-up
highRoas.body: Monitor same-day ROAS; when it hits 250% and conversion volume is on target, automatically increase the ad set's budget by 20% to capture high-performing windows.

creativeViolation.title: Creative violation auto-pause
creativeViolation.body: If the same creative is rejected by the platform more than twice within 24 hours, the system automatically takes it down and instantly notifies the account owner.

keywordRoas.title: Keyword ROAS breach strategy
keywordRoas.body: Detect when a core keyword's ROAS drops below 100% over the past 3 days, automatically lower the bid and switch strategy — stopping losses while preserving traffic.

pixelAlert.title: Pixel data outage alert
pixelAlert.body: Detect in real time when Pixel conversion event volume drops to 0, and automatically send a repair notice before it affects the ad's learning phase.
